description: Budget (Soll) vs actual (Ist) with variance and YTD summary. Requires plan_id from list_budget_plans. detail=summary omits period_rows and row_count (use it for KPI-only questions). Besides the per-category rows (period_rows, ytd_summary) the response carries derived P&L metrics for plan AND actual: `metrics` (per period) and `metrics_ytd` (all periods of the response) with revenue, other_income, cogs, opex, depreciation, financial, tax, gross_margin, ebitda, ebit, ebt and net_income (= Jahresueberschuss), each with budget, actual, variance and variance_pct. They are computed from tenant_config.pnl_labels exactly like get_periodic_summaries.metrics — do NOT sum categories yourself. `unmapped_categories` lists categories with amounts but no subtotal_group (not part of any metric). With cost_center set, actuals of the metrics are tenant-wide (see metrics_note). Account level (granularity=account): one row per account/sub-account of the plan, key "8400" (the main account = sub-account 000, compared against the actuals of the main account only) or "8400/130" (a specific sub-account, compared against that sub-account only) — the two never overlap and are not summed.

date_from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM. Omit for full plan range.

date_to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM. Omit for full plan range.

detail.description: rows (default) = full period_rows + row_count; summary = only ytd_summary, metrics, metrics_ytd and unmapped_categories (small answer for KPI-only questions).

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

plan_id.description: UUID of the budget plan (from list_budget_plans)

name: get_budget_vs_actual
